deferred_changes.reason: Refusal billing is attached to GatewayHandler, but normal Grok traffic uses OpenAIGatewayHandler. Preserve prior billing until the actual path and settlement are covered by endpoint tests.

The shared Chat-to-Responses converter sets store:false; summary-only reasoning items are not portable and the existing OpenAI normalizer removes them. Preserve assistant-message history and exact whitespace until destination support is verified. Output thinking separation and local_shell conversion are imported.

Defer the new parser, bridge and passthrough wiring together: truncated invocations and literal code examples synthesize executable tool calls; generated events violate sequence/index/identity, while partial tags bypass the buffer cap. The passthrough hook is unreachable for normal DeepSeek platform accounts and additionally breaks SSE frame boundaries, final output identities, and preauthorization observation. Preserve existing think/thinking conversion and native structured tools until provider-scoped parsing and real Forward-level streaming/billing regressions are available. The native-account session scheduling change is imported separately.

The standard library HTTP2Config has no independent idle timeout; upstream assigns the h2c timeout to Server.IdleTimeout and changes HTTP/1 connection lifetime. Preserve the existing x/net server setup until separate HTTP/1 and h2c timeout behavior can be retained. The outbound standard library HTTP/2 transport update is imported.

Submit still uses the primary group platform instead of ResolvedTargetPlatform, and a primary-group moderation completion marker can skip target-group policy. Preserve the existing entry platform and image-generation permission rejection until resolved-target authorization and auditing are covered; duplicate-model rejection is imported independently.

Defer both platforms and migration 255 together: connection tests send their credentials to Anthropic and mapped Claude models select the wrong forwarding protocol. Accept the independent protocol compatibility fixes only, pending endpoint tests for credential destinations and mapped-model routing.

Defer all honeypot detection, routes and ban wiring: the keyword heuristic rejects legitimate business queries. The 2.1.3 SigV4 correction does not fix other legitimate query-value false positives. In-flight usage tracking is imported independently with request-thread metadata publication, race-free snapshots, atomic Redis cleanup and stale-response protection. Authentication keeps its existing c.Next flow.

Defer migrations 256a/256b and their binding test: pg_trgm creation may fail silently before unconditional index creation fails; interrupted CONCURRENTLY indexes have no invalid-index recovery. Without these indexes, defer contains-fragment searches too to avoid hot-table scans. Query exact complete request/upstream IDs with existing B-tree indexes, also accepting raw client/local IDs. This production release has no schema changes and retains validate mode.

Defer the new validator and both handler hooks: they check only the public model before channel/account mappings, allowing aliases mapped to Opus5.5 to bypass validation while rejecting Opus5.5 mapped to other models. Preserve existing validation until effective-model routing and original-body semantics are covered together.
